description: Projected GG26 active registration (the election-day 'eligible' measure) and active + inactive by county x party group, with county CVAP.

sources.active_2026_09: voter_registration: report_date 2026-09, active_voters grouped to DEM/REP/OTH
sources.eligible_ratio_2018: turnout_counts official-turnout GG18 eligible (as_of 2018-11-06) / voter_registration 2018-09 active, per county x party group
sources.eligible_ratio_2022: turnout_counts official-turnout GG22 eligible (as_of 2022-12-08) / voter_registration 2022-09 active, per county x party group
sources.active: round(active_2026_09 x eligible_ratio_mean), eligible_ratio_mean = unweighted mean of the 2018 and 2022 ratios
sources.eligible: round(active x (1 + inactive_ratio_mean)), inactive_ratio_mean from inactive_ratio.csv

checks_passed: 24 counties x 3 party groups, no missing values
county x party eligible / September active ratios between 0.5 and 1.5
notes: CVAP is county-level only; it is repeated on each party row and must not be summed across party rows.
